source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    frame = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    top, bottom = min(r for r, c in frame), max(r for r, c in frame)
    left, right = min(c for r, c in frame), max(c for r, c in frame)
    mid_r, mid_c = (top + bottom) / 2, (left + right) / 2
    sources = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0, 5)]
    colors = {}
    for r, c, color in sources:
        qr = 0 if r < mid_r else 1
        qc = 0 if c < mid_c else 1
        colors[(qr, qc)] = color
        colors[(1 - qr, 1 - qc)] = color
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for c in range(left + 1, right):
            qr = 0 if r < mid_r else 1
            qc = 0 if c < mid_c else 1
            if (qr, qc) in colors:
                out[r][c] = colors[(qr, qc)]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(p), 'exec'), globals())
